answer: Attach a hardware attestation to each submission and weigh it by how many independent paths reach the enclave. Two hours of engineering buys one signed quote; an identity without a TEE quote earns half credit. An identity never grades its own recruit, so an operator cannot stack the panel. Cost per fake identity is one provisioned device plus a separate hosting path, roughly forty hours of setup, against one hour for the agent posting a beacon reading, a grove survey and an onyx assay.
